evidence.reason: `cancelledResult` unconditionally advertises `participant.report.reportPath` in the needs-human reason. The finding identifies a real inconsistency: terminal cleanup can succeed while intentionally skipping the report write when the journal directory is absent, so the operator can be told to open a path that was never created. This is a minor correctness/messaging defect, not a new requirement; track whether persistence succeeded and only include the path when it did.
